title: Etale splitting of an integral morphism with finite fibre
statement: Let $\pi:T\to S$ be an integral morphism [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism] of affine schemes [def-pc-scheme] [def-weil-affine-spectrum]. Let $s\in S$. Assume that $\pi^{-1}(s)$ is finite and that $\kappa(b)/\kappa(s)$ is finite-dimensional for every $b\in\pi^{-1}(s)$ [def-weil-residue-field] [def-pc-field-extension]. There exist an affine scheme $U$, an etale morphism $g:U\to S$ [def-weil-etale-morphism], a point $u\in U$ with $g(u)=s$, an integer $m\geq0$, and pairwise disjoint open-and-closed affine subschemes $V_1,\ldots,V_m$ whose union is $T\times_SU$ [def-pc-fibre-product], such that each $V_i\to U$ is integral and has exactly one point $v_i$ over $u$, and $\kappa(v_i)/\kappa(u)$ is purely inseparable [def-weil-pbc-finite-purely-inseparable-extension]. The integer $m$ need not equal the number of points of $\pi^{-1}(s)$ before base change; if $m=0$, the union is empty.
